data.narrative:
Iambic Therapeutics is a Series B-stage biotech company that has raised $350M+ to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comp universe of 11 peers: 3 public companies (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) and 8 private-stage firms in Biotech & Health, including Eikon Therapeutics, Colossal Biosciences, Chai Discovery, and New Limit.

Two valuation methods are applicable. Stage-Progression analysis uses the $350M total raised as a base proxy and applies a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical of Series B advancement, yielding $665M. Peer-Median analysis anchors to 4 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables with a median valuation of $3.5B, though the range is wide: $539M (Eikon Therapeutics) to $10.3B (Colossal Biosciences). Public-comp anchoring via P/S multiples (sector median 6.6x across 3 tickers) cannot be applied due to the absence of Iambic's revenue data, typical for private firms.

Triangulating these two methods produces a valuation range of $565M (low) to $4.0B (high), with a median of $2.1B. The wide range reflects material uncertainty around Iambic's clinical progress, IP strength, and commercial path relative to peers. Stage-Progression suggests conservative downside near $565M, while Peer-Median anchoring to larger Series C rounds implies upside toward $3.5B–$4.0B. Resolution of clinical milestones and capital efficiency will likely narrow this band materially.
